summary: Tested 4 FR UX changes: (1) UserAvatar on Users page & Journal, (2) Live notifications bell w/ dropdown+empty state, (3) User menu Retirer-item removed & replaced with hover pencil (avatar-change) + cross (avatar-remove) overlay, (4) Avatar upload/remove flow. FIXED a critical missing import (UserAvatar) in /app/frontend/src/pages/Users.js that would have crashed the Users page at render time. All flows validated on live preview URL as admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.js was rendering <UserAvatar/> without importing it. Fixed by adding: import { UserAvatar } from '../components/UserAvatar'. Without this the Users page (admin only) would throw a ReferenceError.

Layout.js is ~470 lines and combines multiple concerns (NotificationsBell, UserMenu, NavItem, NavParent, YearControls, CompanySelector). Consider splitting into separate files under components/layout/ for maintainability.
NotificationsBell polls every 60s but does not clear on unmount error paths; catch is silent - consider small toast on repeated failures.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a 1x1 PNG avatar to admin during test then removed via avatar-remove (verified DELETE flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 UX changes validated on live URL. Users page had missing UserAvatar import (now fixed). Notifications bell shows empty state 'Aucune alerte pour le moment 🎉' (data-testid=notif-empty) with green dot indicator (no badge when count=0). User menu no longer contains 'Retirer la photo' item; pencil/cross overlays work via hover on the 14x14 avatar inside DropdownMenuContent header. File input persists outside DropdownMenuContent so upload works even if menu re-opens. Avatar POST /api/me/avatar returns 200. Nav non-regression: dashboard/budget/acct_dashboard/acct_qc9434/journal all clickable.
verified_flows: Users page: 1 admin row with data-testid=user-avatar (initials, size=30)
Journal page: 300 entries each with data-testid=user-avatar (showPhoto=false, initials)
Bell: header-notif-btn opens notif-menu, notif-empty visible, no notif-badge (count=0), green dot indicator
User menu: no menuitem with data-testid=avatar-remove (0 role=menuitem matches)
Avatar upload: pencil overlay (avatar-change) triggers hidden avatar-file-input; POST /api/me/avatar → 200; avatar-remove overlay appears after upload; DELETE via cross returns to initials
